text: Took this pack on a weekend hike. Straps stayed comfy all day, even loaded. That side pocket, though? Awkward to reach with the pack on—nearly ditched my bottle. Main zipper caught once on a seam, then behaved. Solid, not perfect. Would still take it again.
task: Write a fictional first-person review of a backpack after a weekend trip: comfortable straps, awkward side pocket, and a zipper that caught once.
